known_shas_note: Every heartbeat.sh body this package has ever PUBLISHED, newest first, including the current one. APPEND to this list when re-vendoring - never rewrite it, and never drop an entry. The `update` subcommand (src/update.js planScriptRefresh) uses it to tell an older copy of OURS, which it refreshes, from an edit the CUSTOMER made, which it never touches. Dropping a sha silently reclassifies every customer still on that version as having edited the file, and update then leaves them stale forever. Measured with `git show <tag>:src/assets/heartbeat.sh | sha256sum`: 18fbd977 shipped in v2.7.0 (the first release carrying the asset at all), 8992ec0b in v2.7.1.
why_byte_identical: This file is a VERBATIM copy of the origin path at the origin commit, deliberately unmodified - no header was added, because adding one would change the bytes and make a drift check against upstream impossible. Provenance lives here instead. Re-vendor with: cp <idea-base.us>/.claude/hooks/heartbeat.sh src/assets/heartbeat.sh && update sha256 + origin_commit above && PREPEND the new sha256 to known_shas. src/setup.test.js asserts the sha256 recorded here, which catches a local edit, and that sha256 is the first entry of known_shas; byte-identity with upstream is a cross-repo check neither repo's CI can perform today.
